note: The first_nested_pvalue binding is the vulnerable source-level view of the first nested CK_ATTRIBUTE slot that the second decode will read from the raw outer-value buffer. It is captured immediately after `attrs[i].pValue = p11_rpc_message_alloc_extra(msg, temp.ulValueLen)` and before the second `p11_rpc_buffer_get_attribute(...)` call reinterprets those bytes as nested attributes.
